BCP builds a heading id by replacing spaces with underscores, so "BDP175_Colby_Rasmus_AU_RC" detagged to "BDP175 Colby Rasmus AU RC" and became a PARALLEL of every base card on the page. These 466 rows on 2008 topps-co-signers carry 99 distinct such parallels: the row's "parallel" names ANOTHER CARD, often another player entirely (a Verlander BDP129 row whose parallel is "BDP175 Colby Rasmus AU RC"). A row whose parallel is another card is not a card and has no address, so it is RETIRED rather than repointed -- there is no correct destination to guess, and guessing one is what "one card, one row, one pool" forbids. Sales: measured read-only 2026-09-09, the whole 57,803-row population carries ONE sale, so keepSales:true leaves it for the GREAT REMATCH to re-place from the sale title rather than onto a guessed address.
